shots.purpose: Launch the scene as Fuzzby’s self-appointed parade already in motion: funny because his importance is faster than his steering.
shots.performanceAssignment: Fuzzby’s chest and chin lead like he is announcing a parade before his eyes have chosen a route. His wings commit too hard, so every dodge becomes an overcorrection: a shoulder clips one stem, the stem whips back into nearby petals, pollen clings to him, and his attempt to shake it off only throws him into the next near-miss. He refuses to acknowledge any of it until the final pop-back, where he arrests himself in a strained official hover, the body still dusted in evidence. Lip-sync the approved @Audio1 performance exactly; no additional speech.
shots.camera: The camera follows and struggles to keep up with Fuzzby, briefly losing him behind stems and pollen bursts; Zenny remains readable in depth as the calm measure he keeps orbiting past.
shots.openingPose: Bee-height between towering flower stems, Fuzzby already slanting hard across the frame with pollen streaming from his path; Zenny is deeper among the flowers, level and undisturbed over her own work.
shots.cutInMotivation: Cutting to Zenny’s steadier frame is stronger than staying in the chase because remaining continuous would trap us inside Fuzzby’s self-image; the comedy needs his chaos measured against competence, not merely extended.
shots.dialogueBinding: Fuzzby's vocal beat performs per the approved voice design.
shots.visualPayoff: Fuzzby pops back into visibility dusted by the task he meant to command, while pollen hangs behind him like failed parade confetti. Lip-sync the approved @Audio1 performance exactly; no additional speech.
prohibited: Opening frame must already have Fuzzby pitched into travel, not hovering at rest.
Keep Zenny readable in depth as the calm measure while the camera struggles with Fuzzby’s speed.
Pollen and stems must visibly confirm each contact: clip, whip-back, pollen bloom, late recovery.

shots.dialogueTimingProse: Fuzzby’s chant begins after the first committed wingbeat and stays glued to the dodge-hit-recover rhythm, smearing into the mishap. “Nailed it.” lands only after the pop-back and miniature held pose, with a small beat after the final word for pollen drift or body wobble to answer him.
shots.referenceRolesProse: Fuzzby and Zenny character references anchor identity; the approved rainforest flower-corridor scene look anchors bee-scale stems, pollen behavior, soft CGI materials, and warm meadow light.
shots.principalPerformanceApproved: Fuzzby drives the chant as exertion and self-hype — “BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…” — then covers an obvious mishap with “Nailed it.” as if saying it can restore authority. Zenny stays absorbed in her precise gathering, not yet granting him the stage.
shots.animationTimingApproved: Keep the chant on quick, effortful wingbeats: short accelerations, tiny panic-corrections, and no graceful glide. Contacts read in crisp cause-and-effect bursts — hit, spring-back, pollen bloom — with Fuzzby always recovering a fraction late. On “Nailed it.” give him a miniature held pose, just long enough for pride to appear, then let one last pollen drift or body wobble betray the cover-up.

shots.internalConstraints: Hard constraints: no The first tonal inhale belongs to the canopy and rumble, not to Fuzzby’s dialogue; no Fuzzby must become smaller under the changed space rather than re-centered as the authority; no Leaves tremble nervously after his joke; they must not bounce like the earlier playful gag mechanics; no character redesign; no extra characters; no on-screen text; no invented voices; no camera cut; no foreign-language speech; no crystals on the bees; wings continue moving while airborne.

shots.purpose: End on the new power balance: Zenny’s certainty and the darkening canopy make Fuzzby’s brave boast feel tiny but still funny.
shots.performanceAssignment: Zenny’s warning begins in the eyes: they find the sky, hold, then the rest of her body becomes even quieter, as if conserving motion makes the fact clearer. She does not point or dramatize; her stillness is the alarm. Fuzzby answers by inflating the parts he can control — chest out, chin up, official posture — while the part he cannot control gives him away: his hover drifts crooked, dips as the final word lands, and needs a small corrective wingbeat he pretends not to notice.
shots.camera: The camera stays composed enough for Zenny’s certainty to govern the frame, but keeps Fuzzby visibly unstable within it; the shot is a contrast frame, not alternating coverage.
shots.openingPose: Zenny is held still in the flower corridor looking upward while Fuzzby hovers nearer the edge at a crooked height under the darkening leaves.
shots.cutInMotivation: Cutting out after this image is stronger than staying continuous because the scene has handed authority to the storm; holding longer would explain the warning instead of letting the funny-brave denial carry us forward.
shots.dialogueBinding: Zenny's vocal beat performs per the approved voice design.
